data.name: CarpeCarbon
data.description: CarpeCarbon is a Turin-based Italian climate-tech startup founded in 2022, positioned as the first Italian company developing Direct Air Capture technology. It raised a €1.75M pre-seed round in late 2023 from CDP Venture Capital's Tech4Planet, 360 Capital, Club degli Investitori and PiemonteNext to design Italy's first domestic DAC plant in Piedmont, and was opening a €5M seed round to build a pilot plant.
